entries.title: SURGE for Oinja
entries.ai_quote: I developed SURGE for Oinja iteratively with GPT-6 Astra in Codex.

gameplay.input: Pressed Return on Enter Old Harbor Workshop, then held W for about two seconds.
gameplay.response: The 3D run started and continued inside the iframe. HUD showed 240/240 health, 12 kills, 27% Sync, +22 shield, and a 7 m map-support prompt after movement.

warnings: The game remains playable in the restricted player, but reports that settings and run progress cannot be saved there.

entries.title: Magic Carpet Wizard — A Thousand Skies
entries.ai_quote: Video Game made with GPT 6 Astra

gameplay.input: Pressed 1 to cast Fireball and held D to steer for about 800 ms.
gameplay.response: The HUD changed from 16 to 265 points, distance from 2553 m to 2356 m, and speed from 150 to 193 km/h; the Fireball effect message appeared.

entries.title: BLACKWATER · Silent Harbor

gameplay.input: ['Clicked BEGIN OPERATION.', 'Pressed Q and W.', 'Clicked the game scene to fire.']

entries.title: FLOP CLUB
entries.ai_quote: Made with GPT-6-ASTRA. The HTML demo is hosted by Bubu Studio and runs directly in your browser.

gameplay.input: Clicked “Take the leap” and pressed Space for 1 second inside the iframe.
gameplay.response: The embedded game showed altitude 10.4 / airtime 0.09s, then displayed the score 55 result panel and “SIDE QUEST COMPLETE”.

entries.title: 水果忍者 · 再来一刀 / Fruit Ninja Dojo
entries.ai_quote: 一句话生成的，帮我复刻一个水果忍者游戏

gameplay.input: ['Started Arcade mode in the iframe.', 'Dragged horizontally across fruit in the active game.']
gameplay.response: The iframe reached the active Arcade game. After the horizontal swipe, score rose from 0 to 2, best score became 2, combo/heat progress rose from 0 to 2/20, and fruit halves/juice appeared.
